protocol.gc: Explicit renderer HeapProfiler.collectGarbage per sample only. No production GC change, main-process GC or worker-isolate GC was requested.
protocol.processAccounting: Readable observed Linux descendant process tree, smaps_rollup, identity and tree checks. PSS apportions sharing; summed RSS is not total app RAM.
protocol.correctedObserver: Disconnect browser automation, discard test console entries, request renderer GC, sample and detach. Reconnect only for later UI actions.
protocol.baseline: Corrected baseline already has six editors and one prior Memory visit. Earlier connected-observer phases are diagnostic evidence, not a product before/after comparison.

findings.note: One synthetic Linux working-set/retention run. Not an old/new product benchmark, causal savings estimate or proof against leaks elsewhere.

samplerChecks.reproducibleFixturePersistence: six projects and six persisted 24-message chats verified

validation.samplers: syntax and focused accounting checks passed

limits: Initial connected-observer growth was traced to DevTools console roots. Clearing a separate sampling connection alone did not remove the automation connection's handles. Disconnecting that observer released the dialogs; this is measurement cleanup, not an app optimization.
Five samples and two repeated six-project passes cannot establish universal leak freedom, peak RAM, latency distributions or a user-facing memory budget.
Editor text/undo-capable views intentionally remain mounted. Dirty drafts, pending saves, terminals, previews and active agent/provider runs are outside this workload.

External models, detached/reparented helpers, Xvfb display memory and GPU-driver allocations outside readable descendants are excluded. Reads are not atomic and inaccessible procfs parents can hide descendants.
Real inference RAM/VRAM and packaged/macOS/Windows measurements remain open. The large raw heap snapshot is temporary diagnostic data, not a committed or distributed artifact.

cleanup.note: The launch wrapper status is recorded separately; it does not establish the Electron main PID exit code. All seven previously sampled process identities were verified absent.
